scope: Source inventory against the immutable integrated baseline, with explicit pending per-feature owner behavioral audits. No live data, provider call, activation, migration, send or deployment.

definitions.implementation_gap: A requested capability or variant remains absent or only partially supported in this source snapshot. Scope separately identifies whether it belongs to the current demo.
definitions.runtime_activation_gap: Relevant code exists, but intended configuration, review, credentials, mappings, activation or real acceptance evidence is still needed. Policy holds must not be bypassed.
definitions.historical_superseded: Historical choice, explicitly future direction or current non-goal retained for completeness, not an instruction to rebuild or activate it.
definitions.human_submission_fact: Eligibility, rights, attendance, final artifact approval and actual submission cannot be established by source code.
definitions.source_inventory: Previously source-backed inventory references resolved at this current source revision. Behavior is not freshly verified unless the feature owner supplies a scoped result; see the per-feature audit appendix.

activitySnapshot.scope: Fetched integration through PR135. Separate owner branch results retain exact revisions and do not imply current deployment.
